Database.//: On a laboratory LAN, point this at the server's SQL Server Express instance.

Application.//: Language the login screen opens in; each user's own preference applies after sign-in.
Application.//SeedDemoDataOnFirstRun: Shipped false; leave it false in production. true only on a demonstration or training machine (or set MAROCLIS_Application__SeedDemoDataOnFirstRun=true there): it creates DEMO- patients and orders, demo invoices numbered in the real invoice series, and demo.* user accounts (one of them a biologist) whose passwords are published in the source code. Safety nets: the seeder refuses a database that already holds real patients or real invoices, and once such data exists every demo.* account still holding its published password is deactivated, at start-up and at its next sign-in.

OrderRegistration.//: Ten years is the Moroccan minimum for a medical record; a laboratory may keep longer.

Reporting.//: See src/MarocLIS.Reporting/LICENSING.md before setting this to Community.

Labels.//: Windows name of the label printer, exactly as in Devices and Printers. Leave empty and labels come out as a PDF for the operator's viewer instead - which prints to the default printer, so set this on any workstation that has a label printer.

Messaging.//: Sending reports by e-mail and SMS. Left empty, the channel is still offered but only records a send made by other means.

Smtp.//Host: The laboratory's outgoing mail server, e.g. smtp.office365.com, smtp.gmail.com (with an app password), or the host's SMTP.
Smtp.//BccAddress: Optional: an address that receives a copy of every report sent.

Sms.//: Copied from the SMS provider's API documentation. {to}, {sender} and {message} are replaced; local numbers 06... become 2126...

Instruments.//: Set false on workstations that must not drive analysers; only one host should.
Instruments.//ServiceAccount: Non-interactive account analyser results are attributed to. Seeded on first run; the host refuses to start without it rather than borrowing a signed-in operator's name.
